title: Current bg level notification on WearOS
symptom: On WearOS, the user only receives low alarm, high alarm, or bg reading missed alert notifications, but not the current bg level notification that appears on the phone. The user suspects the graph in the notification might prevent the watch from rendering it, and asks if the graph can be removed.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive cause. It is speculated that the graph in the notification might not be renderable on the watch, but this is not confirmed.
fix: No fix is provided. The issue was converted to a discussion because no active developer supports WearOS.
evidence_quote: Maybe my Moto 360 2nd gen cannot render this graph (phone can and shows notification) and won't show notification at all. Adding a checkbox to show/hide graph from notifications and just show bg level and trend might fix this problem but I'm not 100% sure that is the problem.
